name: format
command: akrogon run-check --name 'format' -- sh -c 'akrogon guard ancestors && flock "$(git rev-parse --git-path akrogon-install.lock)" sh -c '"'"'bun install --frozen-lockfile'"'"' && akrogon guard own-modules && sh -c '"'"'bun run format'"'"''

name: test
command: akrogon run-check --name 'test' -- sh -c 'akrogon guard ancestors && flock "$(git rev-parse --git-path akrogon-install.lock)" sh -c '"'"'bun install --frozen-lockfile'"'"' && akrogon guard own-modules && sh -c '"'"'bun test --timeout=30000'"'"''

name: typecheck
command: akrogon run-check --name 'typecheck' -- sh -c 'akrogon guard ancestors && flock "$(git rev-parse --git-path akrogon-install.lock)" sh -c '"'"'bun install --frozen-lockfile'"'"' && akrogon guard own-modules && sh -c '"'"'bun run typecheck'"'"''

name: test_changed
command: akrogon run-check --name 'test_changed' -- sh -c 'akrogon guard ancestors && flock "$(git rev-parse --git-path akrogon-install.lock)" sh -c '"'"'bun install --frozen-lockfile'"'"' && akrogon guard own-modules && sh -c '"'"': "${AKROGON_BASE:?AKROGON_BASE is required}" && bun test --changed="$AKROGON_BASE" --timeout=30000'"'"''
